## Bounded-scope decisions (recorded honestly)

- Wiretap tables emit **document pointers** (the report page's own table
  index) — the per-jurisdiction aggregates ride a follow-up once served
  table bodies are reviewed; judge/officer names are never read (§43.4
  S5).
- The ICE monthly-encounters lane emits PDF **pointers only** (AP-T2-193
  is S3-flagged IND-P8): contents are never fetched, so no per-encounter
  or person-level row can exist by construction.
- DHS + NCES emit the pages' enumerated document pointers; the DHS
  spreadsheet rides its own library-page link (never a guessed file URL).
- FR API pagination: one bounded first page per committed term; deeper
  pages are the cadence job's windowed re-query, recorded not fabricated.
